_note: The exactness anchor: an all-ls outcome node IS an ordered-logit model, so the flow's MLE must equal statsmodels. Multi-phase Adam at restore_best=False reaches it to ~4e-4.

max_abs_diff_flow_vs_statsmodels.why: same sparse level as the classical variant, and an Adam fit at float32 is the least machine-stable path in the repo

ate_abs_diff_flow_vs_statsmodels.why: an Adam fit at float32 against statsmodels: nothing has measured this agreement's cross-machine spread, so the headroom stays

max_abs_diff_named_coefs.why: kept at the classical variant's bound, so the two variants are compared on one scale
